title: Relative torsion-module direct-image bound over a separably closed field
statement: Let k be a separably closed field, Λ a commutative ring in the coefficient universe whose additive group is torsion, and let X,Y be schemes over k. Let f:X→Y be quasi-compact and locally of finite type, a_X:X→Spec(k) and a_Y:Y→Spec(k), with a_Y locally of finite type and f followed by a_Y equal to a_X. Suppose dim(X)≤d for d∈ℕ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For every étale sheaf M of Λ-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the higher direct image R^q f_* M [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is zero whenever q>2d. There is no constructibility, invertibility or properness assumption.

source.place: Geometric-fibre vanishing input in 0F0C/095U; source theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_of_two_mul_lt and its quasi-compact variant.

proof.text: The compatibility with a_Y and the locally finite type assumptions imply that a_X is locally of finite type. Choose m>0 annihilating 1∈Λ; then m annihilates every section of every Λ-module sheaf, so its underlying abelian sheaf and all its restrictions are torsion.

Restrict coefficients to ULift ℤ. Its forgetful functor to abelian sheaves is an equivalence, so the underlying abelian sheaf of an injective ULift ℤ-module sheaf is injective and has no positive cohomology. For each affine étale W→Y put V=W×_Y X. Quasi-compactness of f makes V quasi-compact; it is étale over X and locally finite type over k, hence finite type over k, and dim V≤dim X≤d. The finite-type torsion bound over the separably closed field gives H^q(V,M|_V)=0 for q>2d. The source subsingleton_ext_freeSheaf_of_subsingleton_H_of_acyclic identifies this vanishing with vanishing of the corresponding module Ext group from the free sheaf on V. The free-sheaf pullback identity and derived adjunction identify this Ext group with the value over W of the higher-direct-image presheaf. That presheaf is locally bijective to the higher-direct-image sheaf. Affine étale objects are cover-dense: every local presheaf class is zero on such objects, hence every sheaf section is locally zero and therefore zero. Thus the higher direct image with ULift ℤ coefficients vanishes. This proof also applies to empty V.

The source restriction-of-scalars higher-direct-image isomorphism transfers this vanishing to the forgotten image of R^qf_*M. Restriction of scalars is faithful: if its image of the identity is zero, the identity itself is zero. Hence R^qf_*M is zero. This is the proof of the source quasi-compact variant, which the attached theorem applies after the first step.
